reasons: The sovereign composition contained more than three separately countable shadow-wing silhouettes, violating the one-to-one three-vessel command anatomy.
Four distinct shadow-wing silhouettes remained after correction; the target requires exactly three aligned one-to-one with the vessels.
Two large bilateral multilobed wing systems and multiple secondary humanoids failed exact-three-panel anatomy and the single-subject contract.

anatomyInvariants: An inhumanly beautiful corpse-pale sovereign seated on a blood-glass throne, wearing a finely grown-looking crown and ageless black couture, framed by exactly three tall architectural vessel-backed panels; those three panels themselves are the only segmented pure-shadow wings, one per crest vessel, with no lateral, bilateral, outer, or additional bat-wing silhouettes.

Signature mechanic: First Blood Court: exactly three tall blood-glass vessels and exactly three corresponding vessel-panel wings form a one-to-one command set behind the throne. The selected existing panel unfolds toward its vessel through one visible glass vein; breaking that vein dismisses its command and removes that same panel. No separate wings exist beyond the three vessel panels.
